interpretation: 1.5 milestone, not an admission quota. Report any shortfall explicitly. Preserve the larger long-term goal.
topic_counting: Separate registered, some-content, eight-insight, structural-route-candidate and route-ready counts. Route ready needs a current pinned editorial assessment of a representative evidenced route, a resolved endpoint and explicit limits/gaps. Machine work is not human review.
insight_counting: Count unique visible contributions by their primary subject; shared navigational membership does not multiply the global or subject insight total.
relationships: Admit only independently warranted relationships; no relationship quota.
